specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Flange boss 18 mm, rear plate, washer and nut

gearbox.casing.bell-bolt-medium.name: Bellhousing bolt, medium
gearbox.casing.bell-bolt-medium.notes: The two bolts at the sides of the flange.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Flange boss 18 mm, rear plate, washer and nut

gearbox.casing.bell-bolt-long.name: Bellhousing bolt, long
gearbox.casing.bell-bolt-long.notes: The two upper bolts through the deep bosses on the ears at the top of the flange.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Ear boss 46 mm, rear plate, washer and nut

specs.label: Thread diameter
specs.ref: Fits the 3/8 in holes in the engine rear plate

gearbox.mounting.mounting.name: Gearbox rear mounting
gearbox.mounting.mounting.notes: Bonded rubber mounting, one each side: a steel angle on the pad low on the side of the overdrive main casing (two screws, items 37-38), the rubber block, and a base plate with a stud down through the crossmember ear, plain washer, spring washer and nut underneath (items 34-36). MGOC Spares GEX7422 (mount, gearbox, 3-synchro). Remove the crossmember by taking out the bolts securing the rear mountings (Ch 1 Sec 6 para 35). Form from Fig 1.29 item 33; sizes derived.

specs.label: Height
specs.ref: Casing pad to the crossmember ear (chassis_layout PAD_UP)

gearbox.mounting.mounting-screw.name: Mounting to gearbox screw
gearbox.mounting.mounting-screw.notes: Mounting to gearbox case, 15 to 20 lbf ft (Ch 6 specs).

specs.label: Length
specs.note: GHF120 hex head screw 5/16 UNF x 3/4 listed with the mountings

specs.label: Torque
specs.note: Manual gearbox: mounting to gearbox case 15 to 20 lbf ft (20 to 27 Nm)

gearbox.mounting.crossmember.name: Gearbox rear crossmember
gearbox.mounting.crossmember.notes: Removable crossmember under the gearbox (Ch 1 Sec 6 paras 33-35 and photo 6.33 on early cars; Sec 64 para 9): a pressed channel with its ends flattened and bolted up to the floor beside the tunnel, raised ears under the two mountings, a dip under the overdrive sump. The engine steady rod bracket bolts to it under the overdrive valves (Ch 6 Sec 14 para 1): the two holes in the dip; the rod and bracket are P9. Form from Fig 1.29 item 17; position derived (chassis_layout). Body side bolt points and floor height are the P9/P11 datums.

specs.label: Span
specs.ref: Floor either side of the tunnel (chassis_layout END_LEFT)

gearbox.mounting.stud-nut.name: Mounting stud nut
gearbox.mounting.stud-nut.notes: Under the crossmember; remove to take the crossmember away (Ch 1 Sec 6 para 38).

specs.label: Thread diameter
specs.ref: 3/8 in UNF mounting stud (MGOC GHF202 nut 3/8 UNF listed)

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: ANSI B18.22.1 type A narrow, 3/8 in

gearbox.mounting.crossmember-screw.name: Crossmember to body screw
gearbox.mounting.crossmember-screw.notes: Up through the crossmember ends into the body (Ch 1 Sec 6 para 33, photo 6.33; para 37 'four bolts' on later cars). The body side nuts or tapped plates are P9/P11.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Crossmember end, washer and the body's captive nut

gearbox.overdrive-casing.main-casing.name: Overdrive main casing
gearbox.overdrive-casing.main-casing.notes: The front casing of the unit (Fig 6.13 item 2, "main casing assembly"). Round front flange on the adaptor (gasket 37H1901, P5a) with its spigot in the adaptor register and the eight 1/4 in stud holes, the long stud running back in a groove (Sec 11 para 3); the two operating cylinders bored in the front wall either side of the mainshaft with the four clutch bolt holes above and below them (Fig 6.12 inset, Sec 12 para 22); the cam chamber behind the front wall; the pump bore at the bottom centre under the cam with the grub screw from the front (Sec 12 para 23, Fig 6.12 items 1-3); the relief valve bore beside it; the drain plug with DRAIN cast beside it (Fig 6.18); the filter behind a cover plate on the left (Sec 2 para 5); the operating valve boss on the top right, its plug reached from inside the car (Sec 14 para 5); the lever chamber on the right with the cross-shaft bore, test hole A and the solenoid seat on its rear wall, closed by a cover on three bolts (Sec 13, Fig 6.17); the rear mounting pads low on both sides; ribs over the top; the rear flange tapped for the eight casing studs. Seal the joint to the brake ring with jointing compound (Sec 12 para 20). Proportions from Fig 6.12; sides from Figs 6.17 and 6.18 (solenoid on the right) and Sec 2 para 5 (filter cover on the left); sizes derived (overdrive_layout).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Fig 6.12 scaled at 4.36 px/mm: front face to the brake ring joint

specs.label: Flange diameter
specs.ref: Fig 6.12 scaled (about 186 mm); top kept under the remote housing (P5a REMOTE_BOTTOM_UP)

specs.label: Stud thread
specs.note: Sec 11 para 3: eight nuts on 1/4 in (6.35 mm) studs, one stud longer

gearbox.overdrive-casing.brake-ring.name: Brake ring
gearbox.overdrive-casing.brake-ring.notes: Clamped between the main casing and the rear casing by the eight casing studs; its smaller diameter abuts the main casing (Sec 12 para 20), the inner cone taking the cone clutch's outer lining in overdrive (Fig 6.11 item 2). Tap it with a soft hammer if it sticks (Sec 12 para 4). A raised band round the outside and a slotted lug (Fig 6.13).

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: Fig 6.12 scaled: 815 px across at 4.36 px/mm (187 mm); top kept under the remote housing

gearbox.overdrive-casing.rear-casing.name: Rear casing
gearbox.overdrive-casing.rear-casing.notes: Haynes's legend calls it the intermediate casing; the text calls it the rear casing (Sec 12 paras 4, 9, 21). Front flange on the brake ring, a body stepping down to the housing for the larger front output shaft bearing, a tail with the rear bearing and the oil seal (Fig 6.12); a flat-topped hump over the front (Fig 6.13 item 8); the two bosses the remote control support bracket screws into (P5a datums REMOTE_BRACKET_*); the speedometer drive boss on the right below the output shaft with the lug for the locking screw (Sec 12 paras 9, 15; Fig 6.18 shows the boss on the solenoid side). Remove nut 103 and the flange, then drift the output shaft and annulus forward out of it; the smaller outer bearing stays and is extracted from the rear.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Fig 6.12 scaled: brake ring joint to the seal housing

gearbox.overdrive-casing.od-nut.name: Overdrive to adaptor nut
gearbox.overdrive-casing.od-nut.notes: Eight nuts on the adaptor studs (Sec 11 para 3); MGOC Spares GHF200 plain nut 1/4 UNF. Undo them to separate the overdrive from the gearbox extension (photo 11.3).

gearbox.overdrive-casing.case-stud.name: Casing stud
gearbox.overdrive-casing.case-stud.notes: Studs in the main casing's rear face through the brake ring and the rear casing flange (Sec 12 paras 4, 21: eight nuts and spring washers, undone a turn at a time against the clutch springs).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: 14 mm in the main casing, 16 mm brake ring, 10 mm flange, washer and nut

gearbox.overdrive-casing.case-nut.name: Casing nut
gearbox.overdrive-casing.case-nut.notes: MGOC Spares GHF200 nut 1/4 UNF (the D-type list gives 1/4 UNF nuts and spring washers for both joints).

gearbox.overdrive-casing.filter-cover.name: Filter cover plate
gearbox.overdrive-casing.filter-cover.notes: On the left-hand side of the overdrive (Sec 2 para 5): remove the bolts and washers, the plate and gasket, and pull out the filter. Ensure it does not leak when refilled (para 6). A flat plate with a pressed dish over the filter, four screws (Fig 6.13).

gearbox.overdrive-casing.filter-cover-ga.name: Filter cover gasket
gearbox.overdrive-casing.filter-cover-ga.notes: MGOC Spares 506098 gasket, filter cover, D-type overdrive.

gearbox.overdrive-casing.cover-screw.name: Filter cover screw
gearbox.overdrive-casing.cover-screw.notes: MGOC Spares GHF117 hex head screw 1/4 UNF x 3/4.

specs.label: Length
specs.note: GHF117 hex head screw 1/4 UNF x 3/4

gearbox.overdrive-casing.drain-plug.name: Overdrive drain plug
gearbox.overdrive-casing.drain-plug.notes: The plug marked DRAIN must be removed as well as the gearbox plug when draining (Sec 2 para 4; Fig 6.18). Hexagon head with a flange on a sealing washer (Fig 6.13 item 18).

specs.label: Thread diameter
specs.ref: Fig 6.13 item 18 in proportion to the 1/4 in screws

gearbox.overdrive-casing.plug.name: Pressure take-off plug
gearbox.overdrive-casing.plug.notes: Plug and washer (items 39, 40) closing a drilling on the right of the sump into the pump delivery (D: position; the usual place a pressure gauge is connected on Laycock units).

gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-housing.name: Speedometer drive bearing assembly
gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-housing.notes: The housing the driven gear spindle runs in (MGOC Spares 17H8012, speedometer pinion housing, MGB 3-synchro), in the boss on the right of the rear casing; held by the locking screw (86) and washer (87) over its flange (Sec 12 paras 9, 15). O-ring 84 on the outside, oil seal 90 in the outer end, the cable (here the angle drive) on the thread.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: Fig 6.13 item 88 in proportion to the driven gear

gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-o-ring.name: Speedometer housing O-ring
gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-o-ring.notes: MGOC Spares 506115, O-ring, speedometer pinion housing, D-type.

gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-pin.name: Speedometer housing pin
gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-pin.notes: Pin across the inner end of the housing (Fig 6.13 item 85); position derived.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: In the outer end of the housing

gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-gear.name: Speedometer driven gear
gearbox.overdrive-casing.speedo-gear.notes: Driven by the driving gear (worm) on the output shaft (item 78). MGOC Spares 17H8021 speedometer drive pinion, D-type; their speedometer article gives 21 teeth (white) for chrome bumper overdrive cars and 1280 turns per mile for the overdrive speedometer. Fit after the flange, then the bearing assembly (Sec 12 para 15).

specs.label: Teeth
specs.note: 37H3463 chrome bumper overdrive speedo gear, 21T, white

gearbox.overdrive-casing.lock-screw.name: Speedometer housing locking screw
gearbox.overdrive-casing.lock-screw.notes: Remove it to free the speedometer pinion and bush (Sec 12 para 9).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Into the lug beside the boss

gearbox.overdrive-casing.lock-washer.name: Speedometer housing locking washer
gearbox.overdrive-casing.lock-washer.notes: Washer (87) under the locking screw (Sec 12 para 15); its rim lies over the housing flange.

gearbox.overdrive-casing.angle-drive.name: Speedometer cable angle drive
gearbox.overdrive-casing.angle-drive.notes: Right-angle drive on the speedometer housing thread, turning the drive forward along the car for the cable (MGOC Spares 120694, angle drive, speedometer cable, listed under the MGB 3-synchro external gearbox components; BritishCarForum "MGB laycock type d overdrive 3 syncro" thread mentions keeping the angle drive for the speedo cable). Form derived: knurled nut, body with the bevel gears, threaded output.

specs.label: Output offset
specs.ref: Boss face to the output axis

gearbox.overdrive-casing.cable-end.name: Speedometer cable end
gearbox.overdrive-casing.cable-end.notes: Just the end of the speedometer cable: the knurled nut on the angle drive output, a stub of the outer casing and the inner cable's square. The run to the speedometer is P10/P11 (Ch 1 Sec 6 para 30: disconnect the speedometer cable at the gearbox).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Stub drawn to show the cable leaving forward

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.piston.name: Operating piston
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.piston.notes: In the two cylinders of the main casing, spigoted ends facing the front against the bridge pieces (Sec 12 para 22). Check the bores for scores (para 10).

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Fits the front wall beside the cam chamber (overdrive_layout PISTON_D)

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.piston-o-ri.name: Operating piston O-ring
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.piston-o-ri.notes: Renew if worn or becoming hard (Sec 12 para 10); fit and oil generously (para 22).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.bridge-piec.name: Bridge piece
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.bridge-piec.notes: Over the ends of two clutch bolts in front of each piston (Sec 12 paras 2, 22; Fig 6.12 inset).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.lockwasher.name: Bridge piece lockwasher
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.lockwasher.notes: Tab washers: bend back the tabs, undo the nuts (Sec 12 para 2); turn them up on refitting (para 22).

specs.label: Thread diameter
specs.ref: 5/16 in UNF on the clutch bolts

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cam.name: Pump cam
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cam.notes: Keyed on the mainshaft (P5a keyway at MS_CAM_D); when refitting the overdrive its lowest part must rest against the pump (Sec 11 para 5). Drawn with the low point down.

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.key.name: Pump cam Woodruff key
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.key.notes: MGOC Spares WKN304 Woodruff key 1/2 in.

specs.label: Thickness
specs.ref: 1/2 in Woodruff key, 1/8 in wide (P5a keyway)

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cam-circlip.name: Pump cam circlip
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cam-circlip.notes: MGOC Spares 22H228 circlip, pump drive cam retaining. In the P5a groove behind the cam.

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.pump-plunge.name: Pump plunger
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.pump-plunge.notes: Forked head carrying the pin that rides the cam, stem in the pump body; check plunger and pin for wear (Sec 12 para 10).

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Across the plunger fork under the cam

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.pump-spring.name: Pump plunger spring
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.pump-spring.notes: Must conform to the free length and not be distorted (Sec 12 para 10). Drawn compressed between the plunger head and the pump body.

specs.label: Free length
specs.note: Overdrive spring free lengths: pump spring 2.00 in (50.8 mm)

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.pump-body.name: Pump body
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.pump-body.notes: Small end first into the centre hole at the bottom of the casing, oil inlet facing the rear; tap in until the groove lines up with the grub screw hole (Sec 12 para 23).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.grub-screw.name: Pump body grub screw
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.grub-screw.notes: From the front face into the groove in the pump body (Fig 6.12 item 2; Sec 12 paras 3, 23).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.nrv-body.name: Non-return valve body
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.nrv-body.notes: Screwed into the bottom of the pump body (Sec 12 para 3, Sec 14 para 2).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.nrv-ball.name: Non-return valve ball
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.nrv-ball.notes: Hold it to its spring with petroleum jelly when refitting; tap it into its seat with a soft drift if the seat is suspect (Sec 14 paras 3-4).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.nrv-plug.name: Non-return valve plug
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.nrv-plug.notes: Wired to the relief valve plug (Sec 12 paras 3, 24; Sec 14 para 2).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-body.name: Relief valve body
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-body.notes: Removed with circlip pliers (Sec 14 para 2): two holes in its lower end.

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-plun.name: Relief valve plunger
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-plun.notes: Examine the plunger and seat (Sec 14 para 3).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-plug.name: Relief valve plug
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-plug.notes: Wired to the non-return valve plug (Sec 12 para 24).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-wash.name: Relief valve washer
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.relief-wash.notes: Remember the copper washer between the cap and the main casing (Sec 14 para 4). MGOC Spares lists 506118 fibre sealing washer, oil pressure relief valve (D and LH types).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-valve.name: Operating valve
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-valve.notes: A tube resting on the cross-shaft cam, a seat at its top for the ball, a small hole in its side to keep clean; lift it out with a piece of 1/8 in wire (Sec 14 para 6).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-ball.name: Operating valve ball
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-ball.notes: Lifted 1/32 in when the solenoid is actuated (Sec 14 para 5); remove with a magnet (para 6).

specs.label: Lift
specs.note: Sec 14 para 5: the ball is lifted 1/32 in when the solenoid is actuated

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-plug.name: Operating valve plug
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-plug.notes: On top of the casing; reached by removing the remote control assembly from inside the car (Sec 14 para 5). First thing off when dismantling (Sec 12 para 1).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.filter.name: Filter gauze
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.filter.notes: Behind the cover plate on the left; pull it out and clean it in petrol (Sec 2 para 5). MGOC: D-type filters should be cleaned and reused.

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.sealing-pla.name: Filter sealing plate
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.sealing-pla.notes: The filter seal: refit with the metal surface facing inwards (Sec 2 para 6).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.magnetic-ri.name: Filter magnetic ring
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.magnetic-ri.notes: Clean in petrol with the filter (Sec 2 para 5).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid.name: Overdrive solenoid
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid.notes: MGOC Spares 10002, solenoid assembly, D-type (changeable without removing the engine and gearbox). Flange on the lever chamber's rear wall, plunger forward through it to the lever; hold the plunger by its two flats and screw nut B in or out to adjust (Sec 13 para 4). Draws 2 amps when set right, about 17 if the plunger does not move far enough to switch to the holding coil (para 5). The lead is cut short here; the wiring is P10.

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Fig 6.17 in proportion to the cover

specs.label: Current
specs.note: Sec 13 para 5: about 2 amps with the operating arm correctly set

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid-ga.name: Solenoid gasket
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid-ga.notes: MGOC Spares 7H8196, gasket, solenoid to overdrive unit (A and D type).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid-sc.name: Solenoid screw
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid-sc.notes: MGOC Spares 53K126 screw 10-32 UNF x 1/2 in.

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid-wa.name: Solenoid screw star washer
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.solenoid-wa.notes: MGOC Spares WF702101 star washer, internal, 3/16 in.

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-lever.name: Operating valve lever assembly
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.op-lever.notes: The cross-shaft through the casing from the lever chamber to the operating valve, a cam under the valve, and the outer arm on the solenoid plunger with hole A: with the solenoid energised a 3/16 in rod passes through hole A fully home into the casing when the adjustment is right (Sec 13 para 3, Fig 6.17).

specs.label: Test rod
specs.note: Sec 13 para 3: a 3/16 in (4.76 mm) diameter rod

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.mills-pin.name: Mills pin
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.mills-pin.notes: Grooved pins (items 27, 28) fixing the arm and the cam to the cross-shaft.

specs.label: Section
specs.ref: On the shaft in its bore

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cover.name: Solenoid cover
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cover.notes: Over the lever chamber on three bolts and washers (Sec 13 para 2). MGOC Spares 513204 is the gasket under it (side cover / name plate cover).

gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cover-screw.name: Solenoid cover bolt
gearbox.overdrive-hydraulics.cover-screw.notes: Three bolts and washers (Sec 13 para 2); MGOC Spares GHF117 1/4 UNF x 3/4.

specs.label: Length
specs.note: GHF117 hex head screw 1/4 UNF x 3/4

gearbox.overdrive-internals.clutch-bolt.name: Clutch bolt
gearbox.overdrive-internals.clutch-bolt.notes: Four bolts screwed into the bearing housing with their threaded ends forward (Sec 12 para 18); they pass through the main casing beside the operating cylinders and carry the bridge pieces in front, so the pistons pull the cone clutch forward onto the brake ring (Fig 6.12 inset).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Bearing housing lug to the bridge piece nut (overdrive_layout stations)

gearbox.overdrive-internals.clutch-sprin.name: Clutch spring
gearbox.overdrive-internals.clutch-sprin.notes: On the guide bolts between the main casing and the retainer plate; they hold the cone clutch on the annulus for direct drive (Fig 6.10 item 1). Released as the rear casing nuts are undone (Sec 12 para 4). Drawn at the fitted length.

specs.label: Free length
specs.note: Overdrive spring free lengths: clutch spring 1.51 in (38.4 mm)

specs.label: Fitted length
specs.ref: Main casing pad to the retainer plate (overdrive_layout SPRING_E)

gearbox.overdrive-internals.retainer-pla.name: Spring retainer plate
gearbox.overdrive-internals.retainer-pla.notes: Plate over the bolts the clutch springs bear on (Sec 12 para 18).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.bearing-hous.name: Thrust bearing housing
gearbox.overdrive-internals.bearing-hous.notes: Holds the thrust bearing on the cone clutch hub; the four bolts screw into its lugs. Pull it off with the bearing after removing circlip 58 (Sec 12 para 6).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.thrust-beari.name: Clutch thrust bearing
gearbox.overdrive-internals.thrust-beari.notes: Ball bearing pressed into the housing (Sec 12 para 18); it lets the stationary housing push the turning clutch.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: Fig 6.12 item 7 scaled (45 x 68 x 12 assumed)

gearbox.overdrive-internals.housing-circ.name: Thrust bearing circlip
gearbox.overdrive-internals.housing-circ.notes: Locks the bearing and housing on the clutch hub (Sec 12 paras 6, 18).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.sun-circlip.name: Sun wheel circlip
gearbox.overdrive-internals.sun-circlip.notes: Snap ring on the splined end of the sun wheel in front of the clutch hub (Sec 12 paras 5, 18).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.clutch.name: Cone clutch (sliding member)
gearbox.overdrive-internals.clutch.notes: Slides on the sun wheel splines. Its lined cone ring sits between the annulus cone (direct drive, held there by the springs, Fig 6.10) and the brake ring cone (overdrive, pulled forward by the operating pistons, Fig 6.11). Renew the linings if burnt or worn (Sec 12 para 12). MGOC Spares 17H8017E (sliding member, reconditioned). Drawn in direct drive.

specs.label: Lining outside diameter
specs.ref: Brake ring cone less running clearance (overdrive_layout)

gearbox.overdrive-internals.sun-wheel.name: Sun wheel
gearbox.overdrive-internals.sun-wheel.notes: A sleeve on the mainshaft: splines in front for the cone clutch, the sun gear at the back meshing with the three planets. Can be withdrawn from the carrier once the planets are timed (Sec 12 para 17).

specs.label: Teeth
specs.ref: Tooth counts for 0.802 (Haynes p111) with equal planet spacing: 101 / (101 + 25)

gearbox.overdrive-internals.steady-bush.name: Mainshaft steady bush
gearbox.overdrive-internals.steady-bush.notes: Steady bush for the third motion shaft (Fig 6.13 item 83), fed from the axial mainshaft drilling (Fig 6.15 items 5, 6). Check for wear (Sec 12 para 11). Placed in the sun wheel's front bore (D).

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: Sun wheel bore over the 7/8 in shaft

gearbox.overdrive-internals.planet-carri.name: Planet carrier
gearbox.overdrive-internals.planet-carri.notes: Splined to the mainshaft (Sec 11 para 4). Two plates joined by webs between the three planets, three etched lines on its periphery for timing the planets (Fig 6.16, Sec 12 para 17).

specs.label: Planets
specs.note: Sec 12 para 17: three corresponding lines on the periphery of the planet carrier

gearbox.overdrive-internals.planet.name: Planet wheel
gearbox.overdrive-internals.planet.notes: Part of the planet carrier assembly (66). Each has an etched line, lined up with one on the carrier before the sun wheel goes in (Fig 6.16). Helical teeth (D).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.planet-pin.name: Planet pin
gearbox.overdrive-internals.planet-pin.notes: Part of the planet carrier assembly.

gearbox.overdrive-internals.locating-rin.name: Locating ring
gearbox.overdrive-internals.locating-rin.notes: Locating ring for the third motion shaft (Fig 6.13 item 67), drawn between the sun wheel and the carrier; position derived.

gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-inner.name: Uni-directional clutch inner member
gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-inner.notes: Splined on the mainshaft behind the carrier; twelve ramps for the rollers. As it comes out the rollers fall out (Sec 12 para 7). The outer ring is expanded into the annulus and must not be removed (para 8).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Roller length and the front flange

gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-roller.name: Uni-directional clutch roller
gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-roller.notes: Held in the cage with grease while the inner member is fitted (Sec 12 para 16).

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Inner member ramps to the outer race

gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-spring.name: Uni-directional clutch spring
gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-spring.notes: Fit so that it pushes the rollers up the ramps on the inner member (Sec 12 para 16).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-circlip.name: Uni-directional clutch circlip
gearbox.overdrive-internals.ud-circlip.notes: With the oil thrower, in front of the clutch (Sec 12 paras 7, 16).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.oil-thrower.name: Oil thrower
gearbox.overdrive-internals.oil-thrower.notes: Dished washer in front of the uni-directional clutch, behind the circlip (Sec 12 para 16).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.thrust-washe.name: Thrust washer
gearbox.overdrive-internals.thrust-washe.notes: Legend 'thrust bearing'; refitted before the uni-directional clutch (Sec 12 para 16); check for wear (para 11). MGOC Spares 500613 thrust washer 1/8 in.

gearbox.overdrive-internals.annulus.name: Annulus and output shaft
gearbox.overdrive-internals.annulus.notes: One forging: the annulus with its internal teeth, the outer cone at its front lip for the cone clutch, the uni-directional clutch race in its back wall, then the output shaft with the needle bearing for the mainshaft pilot in its front bore (Sec 11 para 5), the larger front bearing (which comes away with the shaft, Sec 12 para 9), the speedometer drive gear and spacer, the smaller rear bearing, splines for the coupling flange and the thread for the castellated nut. Endfloat 0.005 to 0.010 in, set with shims (Sec 12 para 13).

specs.label: Endfloat
specs.note: Sec 12 para 13: output shaft endfloat 0.005 to 0.010 in (0.13 to 0.25 mm)

gearbox.overdrive-internals.needle-beari.name: Pilot needle bearing
gearbox.overdrive-internals.needle-beari.notes: In the front of the output shaft; the end of the mainshaft enters it (Sec 11 para 5). Lever it out or use an extractor (Sec 12 para 8).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.front-bearin.name: Output shaft front bearing
gearbox.overdrive-internals.front-bearin.notes: The larger inner bearing; comes away with the output shaft (Sec 12 para 9); press off and on by the inner track (Sec 15 para 2). MGOC Spares 134465, bearing, D-type overdrive annulus, front.

gearbox.overdrive-internals.speedo-drive.name: Speedometer driving gear
gearbox.overdrive-internals.speedo-drive.notes: Do not omit it when refitting the annulus and output shaft (Sec 12 para 13). A multi-start worm on the shaft between the bearings (D).

gearbox.overdrive-internals.shim.name: Output shaft shim (thrust washer)
gearbox.overdrive-internals.shim.notes: Selects the output shaft endfloat; four thicknesses 0.090, 0.095, 0.100, 0.105 in (Sec 12 para 13). Drawn at 0.095 in.

gearbox.overdrive-internals.rear-bearing.name: Output shaft rear bearing
gearbox.overdrive-internals.rear-bearing.notes: The smaller outer bearing; stays in the casing and is extracted from the rear (Sec 12 para 9); pressed in by the outer track (Sec 15 para 3). MGOC Spares 533360A.

gearbox.overdrive-internals.rear-seal.name: Rear oil seal
gearbox.overdrive-internals.rear-seal.notes: Renewable with the unit in the car: propeller shaft and flange off, prise or extract the seal, tap a new one in squarely (Sec 15 para 1, photo 15.1). MGOC Spares 7H8325.

gearbox.overdrive-internals.flange.name: Coupling flange
gearbox.overdrive-internals.flange.notes: Splined on the output shaft, its hub running in the rear oil seal; the propeller shaft front flange bolts to its rear face on four bolts and nuts (MGOC Spares lists AAA4039 bolt and BTB753 nut for the propeller shaft flanges; Rimmer Bros gives AAA4039 as 5/16 UNF x 1 1/8). A recess in the rear face takes the washer and nut. P6 datums: overdrive_layout FLANGE_FACE_E, FLANGE_PCD, FLANGE_BOLT.

specs.label: Bolt circle
specs.ref: Hardy Spicer flange proportion inside the 96 mm flange

gearbox.overdrive-internals.flange-nut.name: Flange nut (castellated)
gearbox.overdrive-internals.flange-nut.notes: Tighten to the specified torque and lock with a split pin (Sec 12 para 14).

specs.label: Torque
specs.note: Driveflange nut, overdrive type D: 100 to 130 lbf ft (136 to 176 Nm)

specs.label: Across flats
specs.ref: 3/4 in UNF castellated nut (thread size derived)

gearbox.remote.housing.name: Remote control housing
gearbox.remote.housing.notes: Fig 6.4 item 11: a flanged front box bolted down on the adaptor (gasket 29, dowel 12), a tube back over the overdrive carrying the selector lever shaft, and the lever turret at the rear: the socket the gear lever ball sits in, bosses for the locating pin (17), the reverse plunger (22) with its ball detent (25-28) and the spring plunger (33-36), and two feet bolted (40, 41) to the support bracket (39). The shaft bore is closed at the back by a Welch plug (13); the isolation switch (44) screws into the side of the tube. On overdrive cars the dipstick goes through its front (item 10). Remove its bolts and lift it off (Sec 4 para 4). Form from Fig 6.4; sizes derived.

gearbox.remote.gasket.name: Remote housing gasket
gearbox.remote.gasket.notes: Remote housing to overdrive adaptor, MGOC Spares 22H168.

gearbox.remote.housing-bolt.name: Remote housing bolt
gearbox.remote.housing-bolt.notes: Drawn unnumbered in Fig 6.4 through the housing flange into the adaptor.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Boss 14 mm and 18 mm into the adaptor

gearbox.remote.shaft.name: Selector lever shaft
gearbox.remote.shaft.notes: Turns to choose the selector, slides to move it. Keyed levers front and rear; detent notches for the plunger (53) and a flat for the isolation switch plunger (46).

gearbox.remote.key.name: Woodruff key
gearbox.remote.key.notes: One under each lever on the shaft (Fig 6.4 shows two; Fig 6.3 item 125).

gearbox.remote.rear-lever.name: Rear selector lever
gearbox.remote.rear-lever.notes: Keyed and screwed to the back of the shaft (rear selector screw, item 1); its socket takes the ball on the lower end of the gear lever. Drawn unnumbered in Fig 6.4.

specs.label: Throw
specs.ref: Shaft axis to the gear lever end

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the lever hub, its point in a dimple in the shaft

gearbox.remote.gear-lever.name: Gearchange lever
gearbox.remote.gear-lever.notes: Ball in the turret socket with a slot for the locating pin, a lower ball end in the rear lever, cranked back to the knob. Remove the circlip and pins to take it out (Sec 5 para 29).

gearbox.remote.knob.name: Gear lever knob
gearbox.remote.knob.notes: Pear-shaped knob with the gear positions on top (MGOC Spares 1G3706). The overdrive switch was on the dash on 1963 cars, not in the knob.

gearbox.remote.knob-locknut.name: Knob locknut
gearbox.remote.knob-locknut.notes: Thin 5/16 UNF locknut under the knob (MGOC Spares FNP205); drawn unnumbered in Fig 6.4.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: In the socket under the circlip

gearbox.remote.circlip.name: Lever cover circlip
gearbox.remote.circlip.notes: Remove first to take the lever out (Sec 5 para 29).

gearbox.remote.locating-pin.name: Lever locating pin
gearbox.remote.locating-pin.notes: Screwed through the turret wall into the slot in the lever ball (Sec 5 para 29: remove the pins).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Boss face to the ball slot

gearbox.remote.pin-washer.name: Locating pin washer
gearbox.remote.pin-washer.notes: Drawn under the pin head in Fig 6.4.

gearbox.remote.reverse-plunger.name: Reverse selector plunger
gearbox.remote.reverse-plunger.notes: Spring plunger the lever must be pushed past to select reverse; its peg (24) stops it turning. Removed after the locating pin (Sec 5 para 30).

specs.label: Free length
specs.ref: Behind the plunger in its bore

specs.label: Free length
specs.ref: Plug to ball in the detent bore

gearbox.remote.plunger.name: Lever plunger
gearbox.remote.plunger.notes: Spring plunger on the other side of the lever (Sec 5 para 30).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the rear chamber wall to the ball

specs.label: Free length
specs.ref: Between the cap and the plunger

gearbox.remote.isolation-switch.name: Overdrive isolation switch
gearbox.remote.isolation-switch.notes: Lets the overdrive work only in third and top; screwed into the side of the housing over the shaft, worked by the plunger (46). MGOC Spares BAU1074.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Spring to the flat on the shaft

gearbox.remote.dipstick.name: Dipstick and filler plug
gearbox.remote.dipstick.notes: Combined filler plug and dipstick under a rubber cover in the gearbox tunnel, reached from under the carpet (Sec 2 para 1); pulled out first (Sec 4 para 2). On overdrive cars it goes through the remote housing; its blade reaches the oil in the adaptor and case.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Housing top to below the oil level

gearbox.remote.bracket.name: Remote housing support bracket
gearbox.remote.bracket.notes: Under the turret feet, its legs bolted down to the overdrive casing (screws 38); the overdrive bosses are P5b datums (REMOTE_BRACKET_*).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the foot and the bracket into a nut

gearbox.selectors.rod-12.name: First and second gear selector rod
gearbox.selectors.rod-12.notes: Removed last of the three, after reverse and 3rd/4th (Sec 4 para 9). Three detent notches near the rear end; cross holes for the fork and selector bolts.

gearbox.selectors.rod-34.name: Third and fourth gear selector rod

gearbox.selectors.rod-rev.name: Reverse selector rod
gearbox.selectors.rod-rev.notes: Removed first (Sec 4 para 9). If the rods are tight, take the front cover off and tap them out with a soft drift.

gearbox.selectors.distance-piece.name: Third and fourth rod distance tube
gearbox.selectors.distance-piece.notes: Over the 3rd/4th rod behind its fork, on some models (Sec 4 para 9); ensure it is fitted (Sec 7 para 10).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Fork boss to the next stop

gearbox.selectors.fork-12.name: First and second gear selector fork
gearbox.selectors.fork-12.notes: Engages the collar on first gear. Place the forks first/second, reverse, then third/fourth (Sec 7 para 9, photo 7.9).

specs.label: Tip thickness
specs.ref: In the 6 mm groove in the first gear collar

gearbox.selectors.fork-34.name: Third and fourth gear selector fork

specs.label: Tip thickness
specs.ref: In the 8 mm coupling sleeve groove

gearbox.selectors.fork-rev.name: Reverse selector fork
gearbox.selectors.fork-rev.notes: A dog-leg arm down the left of the gear train to a shoe in the reverse idler's groove (form derived; Fig 6.3 item 58, photo 4.21c).

gearbox.selectors.fork-bolt.name: Fork locating bolt
gearbox.selectors.fork-bolt.notes: Through the fork boss into the hole in the rod; tighten firmly and secure the locknut (Sec 7 para 11). MGOC Spares 2A3492.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the boss into the rod

gearbox.selectors.detent-block.name: Selector rod block
gearbox.selectors.detent-block.notes: Bolted to the casing rear face on two dowels; holds a ball and spring on each rod (Sec 4 para 9, Sec 7 para 10, photo 7.10a).

specs.label: Free length
specs.ref: Ball to the top of the block bore

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the counterbored block into the case

gearbox.selectors.block-washer.name: Selector rod block washer
gearbox.selectors.block-washer.notes: Drawn under the block screw in Fig 6.3 (number 69 is missing from the printed legend).

gearbox.selectors.selector-12.name: First and second gear selector
gearbox.selectors.selector-12.notes: Bolted and wired to the rear end of its rod (Sec 4 para 8, Sec 7 para 12). With all three fitted the cut-outs line up (photo 7.12).

gearbox.selectors.selector-screw.name: Selector locating bolt
gearbox.selectors.selector-screw.notes: Cross-drilled head for the locking wire.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the selector boss into the rod

gearbox.selectors.locking-wire.name: Selector bolt locking wire
gearbox.selectors.locking-wire.notes: Cut through to remove the selectors (Sec 4 para 8); lock the bolt heads to the selectors with wire on assembly (Sec 7 para 12).

gearbox.selectors.interlock-plate.name: Interlock plate
gearbox.selectors.interlock-plate.notes: Lift out the plate and its bracket (Sec 4 para 6); refit with its arms in the cut-outs of the selectors and the side plate in its recess (Sec 7 para 16). Shape derived from Fig 6.3 item 82 and photo 4.17c (later type).

gearbox.selectors.front-lever.name: Front selector lever
gearbox.selectors.front-lever.notes: Keyed and pinch-bolted to the front of the selector lever shaft; its finger sits in the selected selector (Sec 4 para 6: undo its bolt before the extension comes off, or it falls free; Sec 7 para 14).

specs.label: Finger radius
specs.ref: Shaft axis to the selector slots

gearbox.selectors.pinch-bolt.name: Front selector lever bolt
gearbox.selectors.pinch-bolt.notes: Leave it slack until the extension and interlock plate are on (Sec 7 paras 14, 17).

gearbox.shafts.first-motion-shaft.name: First motion shaft
gearbox.shafts.first-motion-shaft.notes: Input shaft: spigot in the crankshaft bush, 23 splines for the driven plate, the plain length through the front cover oil seal, the left-hand thread for its nut (Sec 5 para 7), the bearing seat, the 21-tooth helical constant mesh gear, the fourth gear dog teeth and synchro cone, and the bore for the mainshaft nose needle rollers (Sec 7 para 3). Early 18G (three-bearing engine) shaft with the 0.62 in spigot (MGOC Spares: 0.85 in from October 1964 on the 18GB).

specs.label: Splines
specs.note: Clutch alignment tool for MGB to 1965: 23 splines

specs.label: Bore diameter
specs.ref: Needle rollers 2.5 mm on the 16 mm mainshaft nose

gearbox.shafts.fms-bearing.name: First motion shaft bearing
gearbox.shafts.fms-bearing.notes: Ball bearing in the casing front wall; drive the shaft out of it with a tube on the shoulder and drive it back on the same way (Sec 5 paras 7-8). MGOC Spares 6K885. Size derived (80 x 35 x 21 mm, a 6307 envelope).

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: 6307 size bearing, in proportion to Fig 6.3

gearbox.shafts.fms-ring.name: First motion shaft bearing ring
gearbox.shafts.fms-ring.notes: Spring ring in the bearing's outer race groove, against the casing front face.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: Snap ring for the 80 mm bearing

gearbox.shafts.fms-shim.name: First motion shaft bearing shim
gearbox.shafts.fms-shim.notes: Shims between the bearing and the front cover (Sec 4 para 11, Sec 7 para 7). Shims 0.002 in and 0.004 in (MGOC Spares 6K907, 6K908); one 0.004 in shim shown.

gearbox.shafts.fms-needles.name: Spigot needle rollers
gearbox.shafts.fms-needles.notes: Loose needle rollers in the bore of the first motion shaft, held in with grease while the shaft goes in (Sec 7 para 3, photo 7.3a); one set modelled as one part. MGOC Spares 8G2404.

specs.label: Count
specs.ref: As many 2.5 mm rollers as fill the 9.25 mm pitch circle with clearance

gearbox.shafts.fms-lock-washer.name: First motion shaft lock washer
gearbox.shafts.fms-lock-washer.notes: Tab washer under the nut, inner tab in the shaft keyway, outer tab bent on a nut flat (Sec 5 para 7; MGOC Spares 1A3717).

gearbox.shafts.fms-nut.name: First motion shaft nut
gearbox.shafts.fms-nut.notes: Left-hand thread (Sec 5 para 7; MGOC Spares 1G3584, also the rear hub nut).

specs.label: Across flats
specs.ref: Inside the front cover's bearing recess

gearbox.shafts.mainshaft.name: Mainshaft (third motion shaft), overdrive type
gearbox.shafts.mainshaft.notes: Third motion shaft: nose in the first motion shaft's needle rollers, splines along the gear train with the hole for the third gear locking peg (Fig 6.6 A) and oil holes for the bushes, the centre bearing seat, and on overdrive cars the long tail into the overdrive: the cam seat with a 1/2 in Woodruff keyway (early D type cams are keyed, MGOC Spares WKN304) and its circlip groove, splines for the overdrive clutch and planet carrier, and the pilot that runs in the needle bearing in the overdrive output shaft (Sec 11 para 5). Tail stations are the P5b datums in gearbox_layout (MS_*).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Nose at 31 mm to the pilot end at 508 mm behind the casing front face

gearbox.shafts.oil-restrictor.name: Oil restrictor
gearbox.shafts.oil-restrictor.notes: Plug in the nose of the mainshaft drilling (Fig 6.3 item 96) metering oil to the gear bushes.

gearbox.shafts.centre-bearing.name: Mainshaft centre bearing
gearbox.shafts.centre-bearing.notes: Large ball bearing that comes out with the mainshaft and its housing (Sec 4 para 14). MGOC Spares 503791. Size derived.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: In proportion to the housing in Fig 6.3

gearbox.shafts.bearing-housing.name: Centre bearing housing
gearbox.shafts.bearing-housing.notes: Flanged housing in the rear wall; tap it out from inside at alternate diagonally opposite points, then lever under its lip, taking care of the case and laygear (Sec 4 para 14). Tap it down flush on refitting (Sec 7 para 2).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: In the housing flange and the case

gearbox.shafts.mainshaft-clip.name: Mainshaft clip
gearbox.shafts.mainshaft-clip.notes: Split clip on the mainshaft, overdrive cars (Fig 6.4 item 51); position behind the centre bearing derived.

gearbox.shafts.synchro-hub-34.name: Third and fourth gear synchroniser hub
gearbox.shafts.synchro-hub-34.notes: Splined hub with three slots for the baulk ring lugs and three radial holes for the springs and balls. Slide it off with the baulk rings and sleeve as one; do not pull the sleeve off the hub or the balls and springs fly out (Sec 5 para 9).

gearbox.shafts.coupling-sleeve.name: Third and fourth gear coupling sleeve
gearbox.shafts.coupling-sleeve.notes: Sliding sleeve on the hub with the fork groove; its internal splines engage the dog teeth of third gear or the first motion shaft.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: Fig 6.3 item 114 in proportion to the gears

gearbox.shafts.baulk-ring-34.name: Third and fourth gear baulk ring, front
gearbox.shafts.baulk-ring-34.notes: Bronze ring on the fourth gear cone of the first motion shaft. The coned faces should show clear machining lines and not rock on the gear cone (Sec 5 para 1). MGOC Spares 11G3022.

gearbox.shafts.baulk-ring-34-rear.name: Third and fourth gear baulk ring, rear
gearbox.shafts.baulk-ring-34-rear.notes: On the third gear cone (Sec 5 para 21).

gearbox.shafts.synchro-spring.name: Synchroniser spring
gearbox.shafts.synchro-spring.notes: Three in each synchroniser hub under the balls (MGOC Spares 6K884).

specs.label: Free length
specs.ref: In the hub hole under the ball

specs.label: Diameter
specs.note: BLS109 ball bearing 9/32 in, synchro hubs

gearbox.shafts.third-gear.name: Third speed gear
gearbox.shafts.third-gear.notes: 25-tooth helical gear running on its bush, with the dog teeth and synchro cone forward; the hole in the cone lets the locking peg be pressed down (Sec 5 paras 10, 19; Fig 6.6). Third gear ratio 1.37 to 1.

gearbox.shafts.third-gear-bush.name: Third gear bush
gearbox.shafts.third-gear-bush.notes: Heat to 180-200 C to fit, tongues in line with the shaft splines and the oil holes in line (Sec 5 para 13); fit lug end first with the cut-out over the hole in the mainshaft (Sec 5 para 18, photo 5.18).

gearbox.shafts.interlock-ring.name: Interlocking ring
gearbox.shafts.interlock-ring.notes: Locks the second and third gear bushes to each other (Sec 5 para 17; MGOC Spares 1G3331).

gearbox.shafts.second-gear.name: Second speed gear
gearbox.shafts.second-gear.notes: 31-tooth helical gear on its bush, dog teeth and cone toward the rear for the 1st/2nd synchroniser. Second gear ratio 2.21 to 1. Endfloat between second and third gear is set by the third gear locking washer (Sec 5 para 20).

gearbox.shafts.second-gear-bush.name: Second gear bush
gearbox.shafts.second-gear-bush.notes: Heated and fitted with the oil holes in line and the lugs toward the splined end of the shaft (Sec 5 para 16).

gearbox.shafts.third-gear-washer.name: Third gear locking thrust washer
gearbox.shafts.third-gear-washer.notes: Splined washer over the depressed peg, turned so a spline holds the peg down, then the peg rises into its notch and locks it (Sec 5 paras 10, 19; Fig 6.6). Selective: 0.1565-0.1575, 0.1585-0.1595, 0.1605-0.1615 in to set the 2nd/3rd endfloat (Sec 5 para 20).

specs.label: Thickness
specs.note: Thinnest of the three selective washers

specs.label: Free length
specs.ref: Fig 6.6: hole bottom to the peg

gearbox.shafts.baulk-ring-2.name: Second gear baulk ring
gearbox.shafts.baulk-ring-2.notes: On the second gear cone (Sec 5 para 16, photo 5.16a). Bronze 11G3063; a steel ring 22H249 came with the December 1965 second gear synchro change (MGOC Spares).

gearbox.shafts.synchro-hub-12.name: First and second gear synchroniser hub
gearbox.shafts.synchro-hub-12.notes: Inner member of item 101, splined to the mainshaft, with the three balls and springs (items 102, 103) that hold first gear in neutral (Sec 5 para 12).

specs.label: Width
specs.ref: gearbox_layout.SYN12: long enough to carry first gear into mesh with the laygear

gearbox.shafts.first-gear.name: First speed gear
gearbox.shafts.first-gear.notes: Outer member of the 1st/2nd synchroniser (item 101): 28 straight-cut teeth, the fork collar, internal splines on the hub. Forward it engages the second gear dogs through the baulk ring; back, it meshes the laygear's 11 teeth for first (no synchromesh on first, p111). Keep it on the hub when sliding the assembly off or the balls and springs are lost (Sec 5 para 12). First gear ratio 3.64 to 1.

gearbox.shafts.laygear.name: Laygear (gear unit)
gearbox.shafts.laygear.notes: One-piece cluster: 30-tooth constant mesh, 26-tooth third and 20-tooth second (helical) and 11-tooth first (straight cut), bored for three sets of loose needle rollers (early three-bearing laygear, MGOC Spares 22H54). Endfloat 0.002-0.003 in; measure it with a feeler gauge before dismantling and fit new thrust washers if it exceeds 0.003 in (Sec 4 para 12).

gearbox.shafts.layshaft.name: Layshaft
gearbox.shafts.layshaft.notes: Drifted out forward with a soft rod (Sec 4 para 13); refit with the cutaway end forward so its step lines up with the cut-out in the front cover (Sec 7 paras 4, 7).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through both walls of the 250 mm case, the step proud at the front

gearbox.shafts.lay-thrust-front.name: Laygear front thrust washer
gearbox.shafts.lay-thrust-front.notes: Tagged into the case so it cannot turn. MGOC Spares 1G3576.

gearbox.shafts.lay-thrust-rear.name: Laygear rear thrust washer
gearbox.shafts.lay-thrust-rear.notes: Selective, to set the laygear endfloat: 0.154-0.156, 0.157-0.159, 0.160-0.161 or 0.163-0.164 in (Sec 5 para 3).

specs.label: Thickness
specs.note: Second of the four selective sizes

gearbox.shafts.lay-needles.name: Laygear needle rollers (one set)
gearbox.shafts.lay-needles.notes: Early cars have loose rollers (Sec 5 para 22): the bottom set, the distance tube and the top two sets go on the greased shaft before the laygear is slid over (Sec 5 para 23). One set modelled as one part. MGOC Spares 3H2865A.

specs.label: Count
specs.ref: 2.5 mm rollers round the 0.667 in shaft

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Between the front and middle roller sets

gearbox.shafts.lay-ring.name: Laygear spring ring
gearbox.shafts.lay-ring.notes: One in a groove at each end of the laygear bore (Sec 5 paras 22-23). MGOC Spares 11G3027.

specs.label: Outside diameter
specs.ref: In the groove in the 22 mm bore

gearbox.shafts.reverse-shaft.name: Reverse shaft
gearbox.shafts.reverse-shaft.notes: The cut-out in the shaft must line up under the threaded hole for the locating screw (Sec 7 para 6, photo 7.6a).

gearbox.shafts.reverse-gear.name: Reverse idler gear
gearbox.shafts.reverse-gear.notes: Double idler, 13 and 17 straight-cut teeth, with the groove for the reverse fork; slides forward into mesh with first gear (Sec 4 para 22, photo 4.22). MGOC Spares 22H83. Reverse 4.76 to 1.

gearbox.shafts.reverse-screw.name: Reverse shaft locating screw
gearbox.shafts.reverse-screw.notes: Into the cut-out in the reverse shaft, locked by a tab washer (Sec 4 para 22, Sec 7 para 6; MGOC Spares 1G3581).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the boss into the shaft cut-out

gearbox.stay-rod.bracket.name: Bracket
gearbox.stay-rod.bracket.notes: Screwed to the crossmember dip's two holes (P5b) with its upright to the left of the overdrive sump; position derived (the sump's plugs leave no room for the rod under it).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Bracket base and crossmember, nut under (P5b slot)

gearbox.stay-rod.rod.name: Stay-rod
gearbox.stay-rod.rod.notes: Eye at the front round the rubber bushes on the pin, threaded rear end through the bracket between the buffers. Length derived.

partNumbers.by: MGOC Spares (buffer, rubber, gearbox steady rod)

specs.label: Width
specs.ref: Fig 1.29 proportions, narrow enough to clear the overdrive filter cover's screw

partNumbers.by: MGOC Spares (plate, rubber buffer, gearbox steady rod)
MGOC Spares (tube, distance, gearbox steady rod)

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through both buffers and the bracket's upright, the plates bearing on its ends (2 x 12 mm buffer + 3 mm upright)

partNumbers.by: MGOC Spares (bush, rubber, gearbox steady, front)

gearbox.stay-rod.pin.name: Pin

partNumbers.by: MGOC Spares (pin, front bush, gearbox steady rod, 3 synchro gearbox)

gearbox.stay-rod.pin.notes: Flange screwed under the left side of the gearbox casing (D: no pad is drawn on the P5a casing there), the pin hanging down through the rod's eye.

gearbox.stay-rod.pin-screw.name: Pin flange screw
gearbox.stay-rod.pin-screw.notes: 5/16 in UNF countersunk (D): hex heads under the flange would foul the rod's eye and bushes.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Flange and the casing's tapped hole

ignition.distributor.housing.name: Distributor housing
ignition.distributor.housing.notes: Cast housing pushed into the leaning boss on the right-hand side of the block and held by a single bolt and washer (Ch 1 Sec 16 para 2, Sec 63 para 5). The distributor clamping plate bolts to its flange. Haynes gives no drawing of the housing itself: the spigot, flange and bolt tab are proportioned to the block boss and the 25D4 shank (D). The skew gear path inside the block is approximated: the drive shaft is modelled coaxial with the housing.

specs.label: Bore
specs.ref: Running clearance over the 25D4 shank, 26.8 mm

ignition.distributor.drive-shaft.name: Distributor driveshaft
ignition.distributor.drive-shaft.notes: Skew-geared shaft driven from the camshaft; the offset slot at its top takes the distributor driving dog, set just below horizontal with the large segment uppermost at TDC on No 1 (Ch 1 Sec 63 paras 2-4, Fig 1.26). A 5/16 in UNF bolt - a tappet cover bolt - screws into its head to lift it out (Sec 16 para 3).

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: From the housing face down to the camshaft gear line in the block section

specs.label: Withdrawal thread
specs.note: 5/16 in UNF bolt into the drive head (Sec 16 para 3)

ignition.distributor.housing-bolt.name: Housing retaining bolt
ignition.distributor.housing-bolt.notes: The single retaining bolt for the housing (Sec 16 para 2; Sec 63 para 5 'secure with the bolt and washer').

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the housing tab into the block lug

ignition.distributor.clamp-plate.name: Clamping plate
ignition.distributor.clamp-plate.notes: Split ring round the distributor shank with its pinch bolt, and a tongue with two bolt holes onto the housing flange. Removing the plate bolts and leaving the pinch bolt alone keeps the timing (Sec 6 para 7). Shape from Fig 4.3.

ignition.distributor.pinch-bolt.name: Clamping plate pinch bolt and nut

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Across the split lug in Fig 4.3

ignition.distributor.clamp-bolt.name: Clamping plate bolt
ignition.distributor.clamp-bolt.notes: Sec 6 para 7, "remove the distributor body clamp plate bolts".

ignition.distributor.body.name: Distributor body (Lucas 25D4)
ignition.distributor.body.notes: Lucas 25D4, serial 40897 for 18G high compression. Die-cast body: plain shank in the housing, a waist carrying the vacuum spindle bracket, and a conical bowl with the two clip pivots, the low tension terminal block (item 7) and a lug at the rim (Fig 4.3). Rotor turns anticlockwise seen from above (p95). Shape from Fig 4.3 and Fig 4.2; sizes proportioned from the 66 mm cap.

specs.label: Shank diameter
specs.ref: Proportion from Fig 4.3 against the cap

ignition.distributor.vacuum-unit.name: Vacuum unit
ignition.distributor.vacuum-unit.notes: Diaphragm housing with the pipe union, the threaded spindle through the body bracket and the knurled micrometer adjusting nut held by a small circlip (Sec 6 para 13). Shape from Fig 4.3.

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Proportion from Fig 4.3: a little over half the bowl

ignition.distributor.cap-clip.name: Cap retaining clip
ignition.distributor.cap-clip.notes: Pull away the two clips to lift off the cap (Sec 3 para 1).

ignition.distributor.cap.name: Distributor cap
ignition.distributor.cap.notes: Moulded side-entry cap: the four plug leads enter bosses on the upper wall and are held by pointed screws on the shoulder; the coil lead enters the centre tower. Leads fitted in the order 1-3-4-2 anticlockwise (Sec 2, p95). Four metal segments inside; renew if cracked or the segments are badly burnt (Sec 3 para 1).

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Proportion from Fig 4.3 and the 25D4 body

ignition.distributor.baseplate.name: Contact breaker baseplate and contacts
ignition.distributor.baseplate.notes: Baseplate held by two screws with the earth lead (item 10); the moving plate carries the contact set on its pivot post (Sec 3, Sec 6 para 9).

ignition.distributor.capacitor.name: Capacitor
ignition.distributor.capacitor.notes: Capacity 0.18 to 0.24 microfarad (p95). Suppresses arcing at the contacts (Sec 5).

ignition.distributor.shaft.name: Shaft, action plate, weights, cam and driving dog
ignition.distributor.shaft.notes: Centrifugal advance weights on the action plate turn the four-lobe cam ahead of the shaft as speed rises (Sec 1). The offset driving dog is pinned to the lower end (item 20) and engages the slot in the driveshaft.

specs.label: Dynamic timing
specs.note: Stroboscopic timing at 600 rpm, BTDC, vacuum pipe off

ignition.distributor.ht-lead-1.name: HT lead, No 1 cylinder
ignition.distributor.ht-lead-1.notes: No 1 is the cylinder nearest the radiator (p94).

ignition.distributor.plug-cap.name: Plug cap
ignition.distributor.plug-cap.notes: Moulded cap pushed over the plug terminal (Sec 2 para 4 for the leads).

propshaft.shaft.flange-yoke.name: Flange yoke

partNumbers.by: BMC (MGOC Spares: yoke with drive flange, rear)

propshaft.shaft.flange-yoke.notes: One at each end: the front on the overdrive coupling flange, the rear on the axle pinion flange, four bolts each. A round flange with a recessed face (it clears the overdrive flange's castellated nut and the pinion nut), two forged ears with round eye bosses bored for the bearing cups and grooved for the circlips (Fig 7.1 item 2; photos 5.4b-d). Scratch a mark across the four flanges before removal; the shaft is balanced and must go back in the same position (Sec 3 para 2). Form from Fig 7.1 and the photos; sizes from Fig 7.4 scaled to the 96 mm overdrive flange.

specs.label: Diameter
specs.ref: Matches the overdrive coupling flange (overdrive_layout FLANGE_R)

specs.label: Bolt circle
specs.ref: Overdrive flange pitch circle (P5b, Fig 6.12 scale)

propshaft.shaft.spider.name: Journal (spider)
propshaft.shaft.spider.notes: Journal assembly: square centre, four ground journals drilled for grease, shoulders for the gaskets; the lubricator faces the propeller shaft, not the flange yoke (Sec 4 para 9). Coat the shoulders with shellac on reassembly (Sec 4 para 7).

specs.label: Span
specs.ref: Length across the cups of a GUJ115-size joint (GMB 2151100, as URO URGUJ115 listed for the MGB)

propshaft.shaft.needle-bearing.name: Needle bearing assembly
propshaft.shaft.needle-bearing.notes: Drawn cup with its needle rollers, tapped out of the yoke after the circlip (Sec 4 paras 5-6, Fig 7.2-7.3); assemble the needles with thin grease (para 8).

propshaft.shaft.circlip.name: Bearing circlip
propshaft.shaft.circlip.notes: In the groove of each yoke eye outside the cup (Sec 4 para 5); the lugs as Fig 7.5.

propshaft.shaft.gasket.name: Journal gasket
propshaft.shaft.gasket.notes: Cork gasket on each journal shoulder, sealing the open end of the cup; renew on reassembly (Sec 4 para 8). The sealed type joint has a rubber seal instead (Sec 5).

propshaft.shaft.gasket-retainer.name: Gasket retainer
propshaft.shaft.gasket-retainer.notes: Pressed steel retainer over each gasket, refitted with a hollow drift (Sec 4 para 8).

propshaft.shaft.lubricator.name: Journal lubricator
propshaft.shaft.lubricator.notes: One grease nipple on each joint (Sec 2 para 1), three or four strokes of the gun (para 2). Screwed into the spider's centre on the shaft side, angled between two journals (D).

propshaft.shaft.sleeve-yoke.name: Sleeve yoke (sleeve assembly)

partNumbers.by: BMC (MGOC Spares: yoke with sliding joint, front)

propshaft.shaft.sleeve-yoke.notes: Front yoke with the splined sleeve the shaft slides in (the sliding spline that takes up the axle's fore-and-aft movement, Sec 1). Hexagonal boss for its lubricator (Fig 7.4), thread for the dust cap, an arrow to line up with the arrow on the shaft so the yokes lie in line (Sec 4 para 11, Fig 7.4 yokes A and B). Sizes from Fig 7.4 scaled.

specs.label: Spline length
specs.ref: Stub engaged 27 mm fully extended, 70 mm fully compressed (propshaft_layout)

propshaft.shaft.sleeve-lubricator.name: Sleeve lubricator
propshaft.shaft.sleeve-lubricator.notes: The third nipple, on the sliding yoke (Sec 2 para 1); the only one on the sealed type.

propshaft.shaft.dust-cap.name: Dust cap
propshaft.shaft.dust-cap.notes: Knurled cap screwed onto the end of the sleeve, holding the steel and cork washers round the shaft splines (Sec 4 paras 3, 10-11).

propshaft.shaft.cork-washer.name: Cork washer
propshaft.shaft.cork-washer.notes: Seals the dust cap on the splines; fit a new one (Sec 4 para 10).

propshaft.shaft.shaft.name: Shaft assembly (tube and splined stub)

partNumbers.by: BMC (MGOC Spares: propshaft 31 1/8 in, banjo axle and 3-synchro overdrive)

propshaft.shaft.shaft.notes: Splined stub, swaged cone, the tube with its bands and the rear yoke welded on (Fig 7.4); arrow on the stub (Sec 4 para 11). Shafts of different lengths are used on standard and overdrive cars (Sec 1); this is the overdrive length. Installed at the supplier length 31 1/8 in between the flange faces, 4.3 deg down toward the rear (overdrive flange on the crank axis, pinion 1 in below the axle centre, both level). Tube diameter and the stub from Fig 7.4 scaled.

specs.label: Overall length extended
specs.note: Overall length fully extended, overdrive: 31 7/8 in (81.0 cm)

specs.label: Overall length compressed
specs.note: Fully compressed, overdrive: 30 3/16 in printed as 76.5 cm

specs.label: Shaft assembly length
specs.note: Length of shaft assembly, overdrive: 26 15/32 in printed as 67.0 cm; taken from the rear flange face to the front of the splined stub

specs.label: Installed length
specs.note: AHH7487EOD 31.125 in overall, MGB 1963-67 overdrive banjo axle

specs.label: Stub to joint
specs.ref: Shaft assembly length less the flange face to joint centre

propshaft.shaft.balance-weight.name: Balance weight
propshaft.shaft.balance-weight.notes: The shaft is balanced to fine limits (Sec 3 para 2); the weights are spot welded where the balancing machine put them (positions D).

propshaft.shaft.flange-bolt.name: Flange bolt

partNumbers.by: BMC (MGOC Spares: propshaft rear flange to axle pinion flange; Rimmer Bros 5/16 UNF x 1 1/8)

propshaft.shaft.flange-bolt.notes: Four at each end on three-synchro cars (MGOC); head on the yoke side, as Fig 7.1. Flange nuts 30 to 35 lbf ft (Haynes specifications).

specs.label: Torque
specs.note: Flange nuts 30 to 35 lbf ft (41 to 47 Nm)

propshaft.shaft.flange-nut.name: Flange nut (self-locking)
propshaft.shaft.flange-nut.notes: Self-locking nuts, renewed if possible (Sec 3 paras 3-4); on the companion flange side.

wheels.road-wheels.wheel.name: Wire wheel, 4 1/2J x 14, 60 spokes
wheels.road-wheels.wheel.notes: Well-base rim with the valve hole, the hub shell (inner cone onto the hub, 42 mm series splines, two spoke flanges, outer cone for the spinner) and 60 spokes laced tangentially - inner flange to the rim's outer row, outer flange to the inner row, alternately leading and trailing - with their nipples in the well. Painted aluminium as on early cars (chrome from October 1965, MGOC). Spokes can be re-tensioned at the rim nipples (Sec 30 para 4). Rim contour from the standard J rim; shell and lacing derived.

specs.label: Spokes
specs.note: Centre-lock 60-spoke wire wheels, normally painted aluminium

specs.label: Flange height
specs.ref: Standard J rim flange contour (17.5 mm)

wheels.road-wheels.tyre.name: Tyre, 5.60-14 crossply (tubed)
wheels.road-wheels.tyre.notes: Early models: 5.60 x 14 tubed crossply (H p203). Section 5.60 in; overall diameter from a 92 % profile (car_layout TYRE_D, D); shoulders, sidewall with a rim guard rib, five zig-zag tread ribs with sipes in the manner of the period crossply pattern (D). Pressures: front 18-19, rear 18-22 lbf/in2 (H p203); do not mix crossply and radial (Sec 31). Drawn unladen; the car stands on its laden rolling radius.

specs.label: Overall diameter
specs.ref: 14 in rim + 2 x 0.92 x 5.60 in (car_layout TYRE_D), tread blocks to it

wheels.road-wheels.valve.name: Tube valve
wheels.road-wheels.valve.notes: Valve stem of the inner tube (tubed crossply) through the rim's valve hole, with its cap. The tube inside the tyre is not drawn.

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Through the well to inside the shell's flange

wheels.road-wheels.spinner-lh.name: Knock-on spinner, left-hand side (right-hand thread)
wheels.road-wheels.spinner-lh.notes: Two-eared knock-on spinner (D: two-eared type with the side and UNDO lettered on its face and an arrow showing the way to undo it). On the left-hand hubs: right-hand 12 tpi thread, so forward rotation tightens it (MGOC; P7 SPINNER_HAND); tightened with a copper mallet. Span and boss size derived.

specs.label: Span
specs.ref: Ear tip to ear tip, against the 14 in wheel

wheels.road-wheels.spinner-rh.name: Knock-on spinner, right-hand side (left-hand thread)
wheels.road-wheels.spinner-rh.notes: As the left-hand spinner with a left-hand thread and the arrow the other way (right-hand side of the car).
